question.text: What will be Bitcoin's hash rate on December 31, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Bitcoin's "close" hash rate on December 31, 2026 according to [Coinmetrics.io](https://indexes.coinmetrics.io/cmbihash).
question.fine_print: No other source will be used.

## Bitcoin hash rate on Dec 31, 2026: research brief (as of 2026-11-01)

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-30: The latest daily close on the Coin Metrics CMBIHASH page is **1,036,221.55 PH/s** (about 1,036 EH/s). The page shows a 7-day change of -3.71% and a 1-month change of +8.66%. [Coin Metrics](https://indexes.coinmetrics.io/cmbihash)
- Daily closes for Oct 20-29, 2026: 1,107,622 (20th); 967,859 (21st); 1,044,729 (22nd); 1,076,176 (23rd); 1,002,800 (24th); 1,083,164 (25th); 1,128,587 (26th); 1,069,188 (27th); 1,028,846 (28th); 1,003,033 (29th). [Coin Metrics](https://indexes.coinmetrics.io/cmbihash)
- The daily series is noisy. Over these 10 days it ranged from about 968k to 1,129k, a spread of roughly ±8% around 1.05M, because it appears to be estimated from one day of block production. The Dec 31 close alone decides the question, so this day-to-day noise matters on top of any trend.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The current level (about 1.0 to 1.07M PH/s) sits near the middle of the question's 750k to 1,250k range.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-31: Difficulty rose 5.54% to 148.36T at block 973,728, the 11th increase of 2026 (11 rises and 11 falls so far this year). The article gives network hash rate as 1,064.80 EH/s, down from 1,228.44 EH/s the week before, with a weekly average of 1,053.12 EH/s. The next adjustment, about 12.75 days out, is estimated at **-3.49%** to 143.19T, which points to hash rate leveling off or dipping. [TokenPost](https://tokenpost.com/news/investing/45471)
- 2026-10-30/31: BTC fell below $80k, trading around $76.6k to $79.9k, about 39% below its Oct 2025 high of $126k. The Fed held rates at 3.75-4% with two dissents in favor of a hike. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/10/30/how-much-bitcoin-would-you-need-to-be-a-millionaire-if-it-gets-back-to-its-record-high/), [TalkMarkets](https://talkmarkets.com/article/fed-holds-rates-at-375-4-as-two-dissents-back-a-hike-and-bitcoin-hovers-near-81k)
- 2026-10-22: The 7-day average hash rate rose above 1 ZH/s for the first time since Mar 3, 2026 (BlocksBridge, as cited by KuCoin). Hashprice was about $36.70/PH/day. Another source puts it near $33 more recently. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/bitcoin-hashrate-rebounds-in-2026-what-it-means-for-btc), [search summary/bcointalk](https://bcointalk.com/news/bitcoin-mining-difficulty-revenue)
- 2026-10-16: Difficulty rose 5.92% to 140.58T. The record is 155.97T from Oct 2025. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/bitcoin-hashrate-rebounds-in-2026-what-it-means-for-btc), [CryptoTicker](https://cryptoticker.io/en/bitcoin-price-prediction-mining-difficulty-miner-margin/)
- October 2026: Pickaxe reports range from about 932 to 1,131 EH/s across the month. Their numbers are inconsistent with each other, so treat them as low quality. [Pickaxe](https://www.pickaxe.io/resources/news/bitcoin-hashrate-surges-past-1000-ehs-amid-difficulty-hikes)
- Q3 2026 (Hashrate Index): The 30-day average hash rate was about 940 EH/s, down from 1,004 EH/s in Q2 and 1,066 EH/s in Q1. That is about 12% below the Dec 2025 peak. The causes cited are hashprice in the low $30s, miners moving capacity to AI/HPC (over $70B in contracts), and grid disruption in Iran. US hash rate fell by 30 EH/s quarter over quarter. [Hashrate Index](https://hashrateindex.com/blog/global-hashrate-heatmap-update-q3-2026/)

### 4. Base rates and trend
- Quarterly 30-day averages in 2026: Q1 about 1,066, Q2 about 1,004, Q3 about 940 EH/s. October rebounded to about 1,000 to 1,060 EH/s on a 7-day basis. [Hashrate Index](https://hashrateindex.com/blog/global-hashrate-heatmap-update-q3-2026/)
- Implied peak in Dec 2025: about 1,070 EH/s (940 is roughly 12% below it). An October 2025 peak and a 14% slide from it by Jan 2026 were also reported, but I could not verify those figures. [Hashrate Index](https://hashrateindex.com/blog/global-hashrate-heatmap-update-q3-2026/)
- Earlier year-end reference: about 808 EH/s, a record, on Dec 31, 2024. [The Defiant](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/bitcoin-s-hash-rate-hits-808-eh-s-price-climbs-to-97000-difficulty-up-1-16-459cefb1)
- Difficulty adjustments in 2026 have split evenly, 11 up and 11 down. Over a 2-month window the trend has typically moved about ±5-10%, and Coin Metrics' daily noise adds roughly ±5-8% on a single day.
- I could not find the exact Coin Metrics close for Dec 31, 2025.

### 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction markets on hash rate itself on Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold.
- The closest related markets are on BTC price, which drives hashprice:
  - Kalshi: BTC above $100k before January 2027 is priced at 14%.
  - Kalshi: hitting $70k before $100k by Dec 31 is at 45%.
  - Kalshi: hitting $50k before $100k is at 10%.
  - Kalshi: above $130k by Dec 24, 2026 is at 3%.
- These prices suggest the market expects BTC to stay roughly between $70k and $90k, so hashprice would probably stay weak.
- Polymarket puts the next halving (an April 2028 event) at 58% by Mar 31, 2028. That market tells us nothing about hash rate in Dec 2026.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-12/13: difficulty adjustment, currently estimated at -3.5%. Further adjustments would follow around late November, about Dec 10 and about Dec 24.
- BTC price path: the Fed meeting in December could bring a hike that two FOMC dissenters favored, and BTC has recently been weak at $76-80k. With hashprice around $33-37/PH/day, a further price drop would push older machines offline.
- Seasonal factors: winter in North America and Russia lowers cooling costs and curtailment, but winter grid events such as US cold snaps (for example January 2024/2025 curtailments) can cause sharp short-term drops. Seasonal hydro in Paraguay, Ethiopia and Sichuan is also a factor.
- Miners moving to AI/HPC (MARA, IREN and others) is an ongoing drag on hash rate. New-generation ASIC deliveries push the other way.
- The resolution value is a single day's close, so day-to-day noise of ±5-8% on Dec 31 will matter alongside the trend.

- I could not get older CMBI history (for example the value on Dec 31, 2025) from the page.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet; resolution is 2 months away. The network is currently around 1.0 to 1.1 ZH/s, which is in the upper-middle part of the question's 750k to 1.25M range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-31: CoinWarz showed 1.04 ZH/s, down 9.13% on the day. During October its readings ranged from about 895 EH/s to 1.15 ZH/s. [CoinWarz](https://www.coinwarz.com/bitcoin-hashrate)
- 2026-10-31: Bitcoin fell below $78k to $80k. The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4%, with two dissenters wanting a hike, and a December hike is now seen as possible. [TalkMarkets](https://talkmarkets.com/article/fed-holds-rates-at-375-4-as-two-dissents-back-a-hike-and-bitcoin-hovers-near-81k), [20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/lainformacion/economia-y-finanzas/oro-cae-pese-inflacion-bitcoin-tampoco-responde-que-esta-fallando_7055552_0.html)
- 2026-10-30: KuCoin reported:
  - Difficulty rose 5.54% on Oct 29, from 140.58T to 148.36T, at block 973,728.
  - The 3-day average hash rate was about 1,027 EH/s.
  - Hashprice was about $33/PH/day with BTC around $78k.
  - The next adjustment is expected around Nov 16 (block 975,744), with an early estimate of -3.71%. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/bitcoin-mining-difficulty-increase-miner-profitability)
  - My own arithmetic, not from a source: 148.36T difficulty implies about 1,062 EH/s at 10-minute blocks.
- 2026-10-30: Hashrate Index ran a headline saying network hash rate was back above 1 ZH/s. [Hashrate Index](https://hashrateindex.com/blog/global-hashrate-heatmap-update-q3-2026/)
- 2026-10-22: KuCoin said the 7-day average went above 1 ZH/s for the first time since 2026-03-03. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/bitcoin-hashrate-rebounds-in-2026-what-it-means-for-btc)
- 2026-10-16: Difficulty rose 5.92% to 140.58T. [Bitkub](https://www.bitkub.com/en/blog/bitcoin-mining-difficulty-jumps-592-to-high-7uNgmzahAeVWDSDkyPqM9F)
- Q3 2026: Hashrate Index's quarterly update said:
  - The 30-day average was about 940 EH/s, down 6.3% from Q2. That is the second quarterly decline in a row, and about 12% below the December 2025 peak, which implies a peak of roughly 1.07 ZH/s.
  - Hashprice was in the low $30s. The US lost about 30 EH/s over the quarter.
  - Luxor's Ethan Vera expects hash rate to drift lower until BTC recovers, and noted that capacity moving to AI is a key unknown. [Hashrate Index](https://hashrateindex.com/blog/global-hashrate-heatmap-update-q3-2026/)
- Many of the October figures come from Pickaxe articles that look auto-generated and contradict each other, so I treated them with caution. [Pickaxe](https://www.pickaxe.io/resources/news/bitcoin-hashrate-surges-past-1000-ehs-amid-difficulty-hikes)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent path:
  - December 2025 peak: about 1.07 ZH/s (30-day average).
  - Late 2025: difficulty around 148.2T, near the all-time high of about 155.97T set 2025-10-29. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/bitcoin-mining-difficulty-nears-record-064434953.html), [Millionminer](https://millionminer.com/news/bitcoin-mining-update-october-2026)
  - January 2026: briefly at 1 ZH/s, followed by weather-related drops. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tag/hashrate)
  - Mid-2026 low: about 899 EH/s (7-day average).
  - Q3 2026: about 940 EH/s.
  - Late October 2026: about 1.03 to 1.06 ZH/s.
- Year-over-year, hash rate is roughly flat: difficulty is 148.36T now versus about 148.2T at the end of 2025. This is unusual compared with earlier years, when hash rate grew strongly.
- Typical variation:
  - Difficulty adjustments in October were +5 to 6% per epoch.
  - Over 2026, the 30- to 90-day averages moved by about ±6 to 12% per quarter.
  - On top of that, single-day CMBI values add roughly ±5 to 8% of noise (see section 1).
  - Weather curtailment, for example Texas winter storms, hit hash rate in January 2026. Late December carries some of the same risk.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on Bitcoin hash rate itself.
- BTC price markets, which matter because hashprice drives miner shutdowns:
  - Kalshi gives 45% that BTC hits $70k before $100k by Dec 31.
  - Kalshi gives 10% that it hits $50k before $100k.
  - Kalshi gives 14% that BTC is back above $100k before Jan 2027.
- Polymarket puts the next halving around March to June 2028 (58% by 2028-03-31), so no halving falls inside this window.
- CoinShares said a sustained BTC price below $70k could trigger larger miner capitulation. [CoinShares](https://coinshares.com/corp/insights/research-data/bitcoin-mining-report-q1-2026/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-16: next difficulty adjustment, with an early estimate of -3.7%. After that, adjustments should come about every 2 weeks, roughly late November/early December, mid-December, and around year-end. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/bitcoin-mining-difficulty-increase-miner-profitability)
- 2026-12 FOMC meeting: a possible rate hike could weigh on the BTC price and so on hashprice.
- New-generation ASIC deliveries and energization, which push hash rate up, set against older machines shutting down and capacity moving to AI/HPC, which push it down.
- Possible winter weather curtailment in the US and price-responsive curtailment by Russian and Chinese miners in late December.
- Holiday-period block-time luck. Because the question resolves on one day's close, that noise alone can move the value by ±5 to 8%.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 2 months. The question resolves on the Coin Metrics daily close for December 31, 2026, known around January 1, 2027.

(b) **Latest known value:** 1,036,221.55 PH/s on October 30, 2026 (Coin Metrics CMBIHASH). The October 20-29 daily closes average about 1,051k.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 1,036,000 to 1,050,000 PH/s.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- The October rebound took hash rate from a Q3 average of about 940 EH/s to over 1 ZH/s.
- However, the next difficulty adjustment is projected at -3.5%, which points to a plateau.
- BTC is weak at $76-80k, and hashprice is around $33-37/PH/day.
- On the other side, winter cooling and new ASIC deliveries help, while miners moving capacity to AI/HPC is a drag.
- Net, the trend points to roughly flat to slightly down, around 1,000k to 1,060k PH/s.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- Over 2-month windows, the underlying hash rate has typically moved about ±5-10%.
- The single-day Coin Metrics noise adds roughly ±5-8%.
- Combined, the standard deviation is about 9-10%, or roughly 95-100k PH/s.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- There are no markets on hash rate itself.
- BTC price markets imply a roughly $70-90k range into year end, so hashprice stays weak. Kalshi gives 45% that BTC hits $70k before $100k.
- That is consistent with hash rate being stagnant rather than rising strongly.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** BTC falls toward $50-60k, which pushes older machines offline. A US winter storm on Dec 31 could curtail Texas miners, and a noisy low daily estimate could stack on top. Together these could give about 800k PH/s.
- **High:** BTC rallies toward $100k, large new-generation ASIC fleets get energized, and a lucky high-block day lands on Dec 31. That could give about 1,250-1,300k PH/s.
